Test Case 2: GitHub CLI Installation Validation

Input:
- Pod: devbob-0, devbob-1, devbob-2
- Command: which gh && gh --version

Expected Output:
- /usr/bin/gh or /usr/local/bin/gh
- gh version X.X.X (e.g., gh version 2.40.1)

Validation:
- Output must contain path to gh binary
- Output must contain version information
- Indicates gh CLI is installed and accessible in PATH
